info.title: LibreQoS API
info.description: LibreQoS node API. Every request carries an API key in the `x-bearer` header; the node manager creates and revokes keys under Local API Keys.

get.summary: Count of active circuits within a time window
get.description: Return a count of device rows whose circuit the node saw inside the window. The age comes from the daemon's per-circuit live rollup, which retains a circuit for 30 s after its last activity: ages are exact up to that horizon, and a wider `seconds` is clamped to 30 and reported in `window_seconds`. A circuit with no live sample is not counted, and is never reported as active.

parameters.name: x-bearer
parameters.description: A named or legacy local API key.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Active window in seconds.

200.description: Return 200 OK and a count of active users within the window.

500.description: Return 500 Internal Server Error if the lqosd bus is not available (maybe lqosd isn't running?).

get.summary: List of active circuits within a time window
get.description: Return the device rows whose circuit the node saw inside the window. Each row's `last_seen_nanos` is its circuit's live age and `rtt_current_p50_nanos` its live RTT; both are null when the node has no live sample. The ages are exact up to the daemon's 30 s retention; a wider `seconds` is clamped to 30 s, so rows older than that are not listed (filter on each row's age if a narrower window is needed).

parameters.name: x-bearer
parameters.description: A named or legacy local API key.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Active window in seconds.

200.description: Return 200 OK and a list of active users within the window.

500.description: Return 500 Internal Server Error if the lqosd bus is not available (maybe lqosd isn't running?).

get.summary: Circuits missing activity for longer than the window
get.description: Return the device rows whose circuit the node has not seen inside the window, including circuits it has never seen. The age comes from the daemon's per-circuit live rollup, which retains a circuit for 30 s after its last activity: the window is clamped to that horizon, so this reports "no live sample in the last ~30 s" however wide `seconds` is asked.

parameters.name: x-bearer
parameters.description: A named or legacy local API key.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Inactivity window in seconds.

200.description: Return 200 OK and a list of known circuits inactive for longer than the window.

500.description: Return 500 Internal Server Error if the lqosd bus is not available (maybe lqosd isn't running?).

active.description: Number of device rows whose circuit the node saw inside the window

window_seconds.description:
The window actually applied, in seconds. The node's activity ages come
from a ~30 s retention, so a wider request is answered at
`ACTIVITY_WINDOW_SECS` and reports that here.

ipv4_list.description: IPv4 entries as strings. Either address (default /32) or CIDR.

ipv6_list.description: IPv6 entries as strings. Either address (default /128) or CIDR.

sqm_override.description:
Optional per-circuit SQM override token. Accepts "cake", "fq_codel",
"none", or directional "down_sqm/up_sqm" values like "cake/none" or "/fq_codel".
A single token applies to both directions; empty means use defaults.

AddSiteSpeedRequest.description:
Operator-authored site-speed write. `expires_at_unix` is intentionally not
accepted here: it is the machine-authored (StormGuard) dead-man switch and
is exposed on the response transit instead. Operator entries are immortal.

runtime.description: Runtime ACTIVE/INACTIVE is log-only in v1; always `null`.

oneOf.description: The broker's held maintenance-window record; `null` when nothing is held.

at_capacity.description: True if circuit is at/near capacity (>= threshold)

current_download_bps.description: Current download throughput in bits per second

current_upload_bps.description: Current upload throughput in bits per second

max_download_bps.description: Maximum configured download capacity in bits per second

max_upload_bps.description: Maximum configured upload capacity in bits per second

name.description: Operator-facing display name, or `null` when absent (never empty).

worker_id.description: `null` = the circuit has no owner (the engine sentinel), never 65535/0.

bytes_per_second.description: Current throughput in bytes per second (for context)

device_name.description: The device name associated with this circuit

high_retransmits.description: True if circuit has high retransmits (>= threshold)

ip.description: The IP address of the circuit

bytes_per_second.description: Current bytes-per-second passing through this circuit.

device_names.description: Device names contributing to this circuit rollup.

ip_addrs.description: Active IP addresses contributing to this circuit rollup.

last_seen_nanos.description: Most recent activity age for this circuit, in nanoseconds since boot.

parent_node.description: Effective parent node for this circuit.

rtt_current_p50_nanos.description: Current RTT p50 in nanoseconds, per direction.

tcp_packets.description: Current TCP packet counts, per direction.

tcp_retransmits.description: Current TCP retransmit counts, per direction.

actual_bytes_per_second.description: Current bytes-per-second actually transmitted for this host.

bytes_per_second.description: Current bytes-per-second passing through this host.

ip.description: The IP address of the host.

last_seen_nanos.description:
Age of this row's last activity, in nanoseconds since the circuit was
last seen. `null` = no activity age is reported for this row (the
node has no live sample for it), never "seen just now".

median_latency.description: Median latency for this host at the current time.

parent_node.description: The parent node of the device

plan.description: The current plan for this circuit.

rtt_current_p50_nanos.description:
Current RTT p50 per direction, in nanoseconds. `null` per direction =
no RTT sample for this circuit; v3 never fills an unmeasured leg with 0.

tcp_packets.description: The number of TCP packets per second.

tcp_retransmits.description: TCP Retransmits for this host at the current time.

capacity_threshold_percent.description: Percentage threshold used to determine "at capacity"

circuits.description: List of all circuits with their capacity analysis

circuits_at_capacity_count.description: Number of circuits at or near capacity

circuits.description: List of all circuits with their retransmit analysis

high_retransmit_count.description: Number of circuits with high retransmits

retransmit_threshold_percent.description: Percentage threshold used to determine "high retransmits"

shaping.description: The CPU list the shaping path uses (separate from `possible`).

per_cpu.description: One row per sampled CPU. `cpu_id:null` = the CPU-id join is unproven.

cpu_topology.description: Shaping-CPU topology (the boot-time detector; not a worker-lcore claim).

generated_at_unix.description: Unix seconds when this response was assembled.

moves.description: Recent ownership moves. v1 has no history source: honest-empty.

ownership.description: Applied circuit/node ownership sets and crossings.

state.description:
`ok` only when every documented source is available (CPU usage,
topology, bridge, workers, ownership, moves); `partial` when at least
one source is available but another is unavailable (v1 moves is always
unsupported, so a working bridge is `partial`); `unavailable` when no
source is available.

unavailable_reasons.description: Honest reasons for every unavailable section (deduped, display order).

bits_per_second.description:
Delivered rate: on a v3 node every forwarded packet is shaped, so this
is the shaped series rather than a pre-shaping demand figure.

build_rev.description: Bridge build revision, `"unknown"`, or null when unavailable.

class.description: The human label of the held pause class.

first_deferred_unix.description: Unix seconds the held change was FIRST deferred (the force clock).

forced.description: Whether the `force_apply_hours` bound has fired for this hold.

held_ops.description: The op count of the currently-held coalesced net delta.

end_status.description:
Has the connection ended?
0 = Alive, 1 = FIN, 2 = RST

last_seen.description: Time (nanos) when the connection was last seen

src_port.description: Source port number, or ICMP type.

start_time.description:
Padding to align the structure to 16 bytes.
Time (nanos) when the connection was established

not_reporting_recently.description:
Count of device rows with no live activity sample. The node retains a
circuit's live row for ~30 s, so this is "not seen in the last 30 s" —
a wider window is not answerable, and `null` means the rollup read failed.

ok.description: Service is up and responding to bus ping

scheduler_running.description: If known, whether the scheduler is running

ip.description: IP address for this hop's responding node

rtts_ms.description: Round-trip times in milliseconds for each probe that reached this node

backward_loss_pct.description: Backward loss percentage for this hop (0-100)

forward_loss_pct.description: Forward loss percentage for this hop (0-100)

loss_pct.description: Overall loss percentage for this hop (0-100)

nodes.description: Responding nodes at this hop (if any); empty implies all probes timed out

bits_per_second.description: The current bits-per-second passing through this host.

circuit_name.description: The host's mapped circuit name, if known

ip_address.description: The host's IP address, as detected by the XDP program.

median_tcp_rtt.description: Median TCP round-trip-time for this host at the current time.

packets_per_second.description:
The current packets-per-second passing through this host. Tuple
0 is download, tuple 1 is upload.

tcp_retransmits.description: TCP Retransmits for this host at the current time.

source_version.description: The package version with a trailing `.YYYYmmddHHMM` stamp removed.

ipv4_list.description: IPv4 entries as strings. Either address (default /32) or CIDR.

ipv6_list.description: IPv6 entries as strings. Either address (default /128) or CIDR.

sqm_override.description:
Optional per-circuit SQM override token. Accepts "cake", "fq_codel",
"none", or directional "down_sqm/up_sqm" values like "cake/none" or "/fq_codel".
A single token applies to both directions; empty means use defaults.

current_retransmits_percent.description:
Current TCP retransmits as a percentage (0.0–100.0)
Note: This is already scaled to percent. Do not divide again.

immediate_parent.description: The immediate parent node in the tree

max_permitted_throughput_mbps.description:
Max throughput for node (not clamped), in Mbps (download, upload).
Values may be fractional.

type.description: The type of node (site, ap, etc.)

name.description: Operator-facing display name, or `null` when absent (never empty).

changed.description: True if a change was made (where applicable)

unowned_circuits.description: Circuits whose owner is the engine's `u16::MAX` sentinel.

circuit_id.description: The circuit ID that was probed

oneOf.description: At least one host responded to ping

label.description: Optional label (device name) associated with the IP

oneOf.description: None of the probed IPs responded within the timeout

ip_address.description: The IP address that was probed

label.description: Optional label (not used for direct IP)

download_total.description: Fifteen download QoO history blocks, oldest to newest.

upload_total.description: Fifteen upload QoO history blocks, oldest to newest.

label.description: Display label for the QoO row.

latest.description: Latest download and upload QoO scores.

buckets.description: RTT histogram buckets containing the count of measurements in each bucket

error.description: Any error message reported by integrations

circuit_hash.description: Hash of the circuit ID, used for internal lookups.

circuit_id.description:
The ID of the circuit to which the device belongs. Circuits are 1:many,
multiple devices may be in a single circuit.

circuit_name.description:
The name of the circuit. Since we're in a flat file, circuit names
must match.

device_hash.description: Hash of the device ID, used for internal lookups.

device_id.description: The device identification, typically drawn from a management tool.

device_name.description: The display name of the device.

download_min_mbps.description:
Minimum download: this is the bandwidth level the shaper will try
to ensure is always available.

ipv4.description:
A list of all IPv4 addresses and CIDR subnets associated with the
device. For example, ("192.168.1.0", 24) is equivalent to
"192.168.1.0/24"

ipv6.description:
A list of all IPv4 addresses and CIDR subnets associated with the
device.

mac.description:
The device's MAC address. This isn't actually used, it exists for
convenient mapping/seraching.

parent_hash.description: Hash of the parent node, used for internal lookups.

parent_node.description: The parent node of the device, derived from `network.json`

sqm_override.description:
Optional per-circuit SQM override token. Accepts "cake", "fq_codel",
"none", or directional "down_sqm/up_sqm" values like "cake/none" or "/fq_codel".
A single token applies to both directions; empty means use defaults.

upload_min_mbps.description:
Minimum upload: this is the bandwidth level the shaper will try to
ensure is always available.

shaped_bits_per_second.description:
Traffic that is shaped (under QoS control). On a v3 node this is the
delivered rate: every packet the bridge forwards is shaped.

oneOf.description:
Percentage of traffic that is shaped. Always `null` on v3: with no
unshaped measurement the split is not derivable, so the endpoint never
reports a fabricated 100%.

Traffic that is not shaped. v3 does not measure an unshaped class, so
this is always `null` — never a fabricated 0.

absent (never a fabricated 0).
